name: gogi
description: Gōgi (合議) — a Claude Code plugin that runs any engineering request as a small council of roles that agree before anyone acts.

plugins.name: gogi
plugins.description: Intent-routed multi-agent team: coordinator + dev + techlead + po (PO/BA) + investigator, with agreement-before-code, an autonomy level (low/high/full), frozen-tree reviews, run knowledge hub, comms log, token stats and learned user preferences.
